name: Megichan no Enikki
source:
This is a side story to Ame Omoi, Kimi Idaku.

You don’t need to have played the main story—though it helps if you have.
A laid back, kinda lazy? picture diary style sound novel released during Golden Week 2009.

Playtime: Less than 3 minutes.
Please listen to what Megichan has to say.
If you look closely... something might feel a little off.
